name: mod-next-steps
description: After each finished turn, up to three short next-prompt suggestions sit above the input as one-line rows; a click fills the prompt without sending

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Entries shimmer while they wait. Hover colors also fade. Off, everything draws still

enabled.title: Suggest next steps
enabled.description: Lists next prompts after a turn. After each finished turn, the model writes a few and lists them above the input. Off, no request is made

count.title: Suggestions
count.description: How many suggestions to show, 1 to 3

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: auto picks Nerd Font or safe glyphs. It uses Nerd Font icons when Windows Terminal runs a Nerd Font, and safe Unicode glyphs elsewhere. nerd and safe force one
